summary: And I do proofread sometimes after publishing. I would rather get content out there. I fix it back on my website but my syndicated thrown into the wind maintain the mistakes. I am okay with this, imagine if we had to spell every word before we spoke. No one would talk.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: And I do proofread sometimes after publishing. I would rather get content out there. I fix it back on my website but my syndicated thrown into the wind maintain the mistakes. I am okay with this, imagine if we had to spell every word before we spoke. No one would talk.
